summary: Build backend and frontend release images per architecture in parallel, reuse protected registry caches, and assemble immutable multi-platform manifests.
security: Each architecture is built from the exact immutable source revision with persisted Git credentials disabled.
Manifest publication retains OCI revision/version labels, signatures, attestations, and provenance verification.
documentation: Workflow summaries identify component, architecture, cache namespace, source revision, and final manifest digest.
knownLimitations: The workflow uses QEMU when native arm64 runner capacity is unavailable; this fallback remains slower than native execution.
rollback: Revert the reusable image workflow to the previous serialized multi-platform build; already published immutable digests remain valid.
validation: Workflow contracts verify the four component/platform build jobs, protected registry cache configuration, exact source checkout, manifest assembly, OCI metadata, signing, and provenance checks.
Actionlint validates the reusable workflow syntax and expressions.
